core_memory.user_preference_espresso: Michael prefers a sleek, modern espresso machine with a stainless-steel finish, aiming for a café-like experience without being overly complex. He values design aesthetics and is open to models with smart features or programmable functions but wants simplicity for a non-professional user.
core_memory.user_inquiry_pricing: Michael is interested in pricing for espresso machines and is specifically looking for first-time buyer discounts, new customer offers, or bundle deals. He saw a 'New Customer Discount' on the homepage but didn’t click it in time.
core_memory.user_shipping_inquiry: Michael in Seattle wants local shipping for faster delivery. He needs the coffee machine before a family gathering later this month. Concerned about rainy weather and delivery times.
